name: Scinorx AI Commerce Snapshot
author: Scinorx Technologies Inc

sections.description:
Scinorx AI Commerce Snapshot helps WooCommerce store administrators understand whether a store has the basic foundations needed for AI shopping discovery, Merchant Center preparation, product feed quality, and future UCP-style commerce workflows.

The plugin creates a local snapshot covering:

  • WooCommerce activation, HTTPS, search visibility, permalinks, store address, country, and product count
  • Product data quality across SKU, price, image, category, description, stock status, shipping data, attributes, and GTIN/MPN-style identifier signals
  • Common Merchant Center feed plugin signals
  • Return, refund, shipping, contact, terms, and privacy page signals
  • WooCommerce shipping method and payment gateway readiness
  • Common Google Pay-capable payment provider signals
  • AI discovery checks for product schema, robots.txt, llms.txt, and /.well-known/ucp
  • Product-level native commerce checkout candidate status
  • A prioritized action plan for store owners and developers
  • A copyable Merchant Center supplemental feed starter for planning
  • A copyable UCP profile planning draft for developer handoff
  • A copyable plain-text diagnosis for internal review

This plugin is intentionally diagnostic. It does not change checkout, create orders, publish UCP endpoints, connect to Google, submit Merchant Center data, sync product feeds, add tracking scripts, or automatically apply recommendations. The feed starter and UCP profile draft are shown as copyable planning material only.

Scinorx AI Commerce Snapshot is useful before applying for advanced AI commerce programs, preparing a WooCommerce store for Merchant Center cleanup, improving product feed quality, or asking a developer to review agentic commerce readiness.

This plugin is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google, WooCommerce, or the Universal Commerce Protocol project. Google, WooCommerce, and other names are used only to describe compatibility and readiness checks.

Privacy

The plugin does not send data to Scinorx Technologies or any third party automatically.

It does not use telemetry, analytics, hidden tracking, background reporting, or background API submission.

The snapshot is generated locally in WordPress admin. An administrator may optionally submit the diagnosis to Scinorx Technologies from the plugin page. The form clearly states what is being sent and requires explicit consent before submission.

External Services

This plugin does not contact an external API or background service.

When an administrator intentionally submits the optional “Send diagnosis to Scinorx” form, the plugin sends an email using WordPress mail to support@scinorx.com. Depending on the site’s mail configuration, delivery may be handled by the site’s hosting provider or configured SMTP/mail service.

That email includes the submitted name, reply email, website URL, optional message, plugin version, WordPress version, PHP version, scan timestamp, scan score, WooCommerce readiness signals, product readiness signals, endpoint checks, finding titles, and recommendations. This is used so Scinorx can review the diagnosis and respond to the site owner or administrator.

Scinorx privacy policy: https://scinorx.com/privacy-policy/

The plugin also performs local HTTP requests to the same WordPress site where the plugin is installed. It checks the site’s homepage-related public endpoints such as /robots.txt, /llms.txt, /.well-known/ucp, and one sample product page when available. These requests are made to the same site, not to Scinorx, Google, or any third-party service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/scinorx-ai-commerce-snapshot directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open AI Commerce in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Review the score, findings, product data table, endpoint checks, and copyable diagnosis.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin integrate my store with Google UCP?

No. The first version is a readiness diagnostic. It does not publish production UCP endpoints, submit Merchant Center data, or create checkout APIs. It provides a copyable planning draft so a developer can see what a future implementation would need.

Does this plugin change WooCommerce checkout?

No. It does not change checkout, carts, orders, products, payment gateways, shipping methods, or customer-facing templates.

Does this plugin send my store data to Scinorx automatically?

No. Nothing is sent automatically. The optional diagnosis form sends data only when an administrator submits it and checks the consent box.

Does this plugin guarantee eligibility for Google, Merchant Center, or agentic commerce programs?

No. It identifies common readiness gaps. Final eligibility depends on the merchant’s account, policies, product data, payment setup, technical implementation, and platform review.

Does the supplemental feed starter submit products to Merchant Center?

No. It is a copyable planning starter shown inside WordPress admin. Store owners must validate product IDs, policy eligibility, required attributes, and feed formatting before using anything in Merchant Center.

Why does the plugin check /.well-known/ucp?

UCP-style commerce integrations use public discovery profiles. This plugin checks whether a profile already exists so administrators can see whether that future integration layer is missing, present, or invalid.

Why does the plugin scan only recent products?

The first version scans up to 40 recently modified published WooCommerce products. This keeps the snapshot fast and focused while still revealing common catalog readiness problems.
